messages:
claire: Quick sync thread — need alignment on tenant-aware routing feature. Product wants staged rollout, but infra/runtime/security dependencies could reorder. Can we call out owners and a go/no-go gating checklist?

ravi: I'm available. What are the performance targets and which customers are in wave1?

claire: Targets: peak 10k req/s, p95 <= 150ms/token for GA. Wave1 = internal + 3 pilot customers (opt-in). Wave1 SLO relaxed: p95 <= 350ms.

jamal: Runtime concerns: KV cache per tenant drives memory. Two options — shard caches by tenant group or use shared cache with TTL. Sharding needs infra network tuning. For Wave1 shared cache + tighter TTL is OK. Owner: runtime (me).

sofia: Security: per-tenant encryption-at-rest + key separation required for GA. HSM-backed KMS integration will take ~3w including audit. For Wave1 we can use tenant-scoped keys without HSM but must restrict to pilot customers and add enhanced logging. Owner: security.

claire: Product proposes 2-stage launch: Stage A (Pilot): shared cache, software KMS, feature-flagged, opt-in pilots, relaxed SLO. Stage B (GA): sharded caches, HSM-backed KMS, strict SLOs and open signup. Proposed cadence: Stage A = 5w, Stage B = +4w after HSM ready.

jamal: I'll produce a runtime runbook for Stage A: batching policy, prewarm counts, cache TTLs, and rollback steps. Prewarm example:
```
# prewarm example
./prewarm --model=rw-13b --replicas=6 --strategy=continuous --warmup=45
```

ravi: Infra needs: reserved GPU pool, VPC egress rules per-tenant routing, and KMS connector for HSM in Stage B. Reserving GPUs for Stage A (6 replicas) + burst = 8. I'll estimate costs and open INF ticket.

sofia: Gating checklist for Stage B (GA) draft: 1) HSM audit complete, 2) KMS rotation tested, 3) tenant key segregation validated, 4) IDS/forensics logging in place, 5) rollback window and rate-limit safe guards. I'll post a formal doc tomorrow.

claire: Good. Risk callouts: - cache thrash on high-cardinality tenants, - elevated token cost if batching too small, - latency spikes during rollouts. We should define acceptable rollback metrics (error rate > 1% or p95 jump > 2x).

jamal: Agreed. I'll add health-check hooks and a canary ramp plan to the runbook. Canary plan: 1% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24-48h with automated abort on thresholds.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7862 "tenant-routing pilot infra reservations" and linked this thread.

ravi: Thanks. Action owners: claire -> finalize product PRD and pilot customer list; jamal -> runtime runbook + canary; ravi -> infra reservations + cost estimate; sofia -> HSM gating checklist and audit plan.

claire: Can everyone react if they agree to the staged plan and owners? :eyes: 

jamal: Agree :white_check_mark:

sofia: Agree for Pilot; GA requires HSM completed :white_check_mark:

ravi: Agree with owners. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow at 10am PT to lock timelines.

claire: Thanks all — will post PRD link and wave1 customer names after this thread.
